page.layout: One printed page, title page text in a single column, centred; show-through of the page behind (faint running head and text) is ignored. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DISPVTATIO DE MAIESTATE HOMINIS CHRISti, ad normam verae piaeque doctrinae per Thefes explicata, aduerfus impias Iacobi Andreae Schmidelini Thefes, Tubingae olim propofitas.
main_text.l: Ingolstadij primùm anno M.D.LXIIII excufa. Deinde anno LXXI. witebergae iuffu rectoris fecundò, ac nunc hìc tertiò, propter graues caufas, recufa.
Æquus iudicet Lector, & veritatem contra falsitatem ingenuè tueatur.

page.notes: Title page with a printed woodcut device at the top right (not transcribed). The first heading line is "DISPVTATIO DE MA-" with the word continued as "IESTATE" on the next line; the hyphenated line breaks are kept by the layout. The imprint line uses italic type with a reversed-C style date "CIↃ" rendered here as M.D. "LXIIII" and "LXXI" as printed. The lower half of the page shows only faint show-through and is not transcribed.
